class.name: SpineTransformConstraint
class.brief_description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a transform constraint. A transform constraint adjusts the world transform of the constrained bones to match that of the source bone. Constraint mix values live on [code]SpineTransformConstraintPose[/code]. Read them with [code]get_pose()[/code] or [code]get_applied_pose()[/code]. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-transform-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_applied_pose
method.description: Returns the pose last applied to the skeleton by [code]SpineAnimationState.apply()[/code].

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that will be modified by this transform constraint. Modifying the array has no effect.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The transform constraint's setup pose data.

method.name: get_pose
method.description: Returns the current pose for this transform constraint.

method.name: get_source
method.description: The source bone whose world transform is copied to the constrained bones.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether this transform constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_active
method.description: Sets whether this transform constraint is active. When inactive, the constraint is not applied.

method.name: set_source
method.description: Sets the source bone whose world transform is copied to constrained bones.

method.name: update
method.description: Applies the transform constraint so constrained bones match the source bone transform.
